say:1:1422640001:1.text: At Elona's warning, I came swiftly with Bryon at my side. I did not expect to find you here... along with our new guest.
say:1:1422640001:1.source_cn: 听到艾洛娜示警，我就带着布莱恩赶来了，没想到是你们——...

say:2:1422640002:1.text: A guest in your company who managed to startle Mysalind... I can only assume this friend hails from somewhere unusual.
say:2:1422640002:1.source_cn: 在你们的陪伴下，还会惊动迈萨林德，想必这位朋友必定有些...

say:3:1422640003:1.text: Master Arden, I am called Indris, born of the Essail clan of Sal'thorin. Two thousand years ago, my forebearers left the Dark Forest.
say:3:1422640003:1.source_cn: 雅顿贤者，我名为因度厄，来自萨洛克兰的艾塞勒一族。我的...

say:4:1422640004:1.text: Apologies, but the tale of my people is so tangled that I hardly know where to begin. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could I trouble you to help explain it to them?
say:4:1422640004:1.male: Apologies, but the tale of my people is so tangled that I hardly know where to begin. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could I trouble you to help explain it to them?
say:4:1422640004:1.female: Apologies, but the tale of my people is so tangled that I hardly know where to begin. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could I trouble you to help explain it to them?

choice_prompt:5:1422640004.text: Apologies, but the tale of my people is so tangled that I hardly know where to begin. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could I trouble you to help explain it to them?
choice_prompt:5:1422640004.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，抱歉，这故事太过复杂，我不知从何说起。能否请你帮我向他们解释一下？
choice_prompt:5:1422640004.male: Apologies, but the tale of my people is so tangled that I hardly know where to begin. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could I trouble you to help explain it to them?
choice_prompt:5:1422640004.female: Apologies, but the tale of my people is so tangled that I hardly know where to begin. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could I trouble you to help explain it to them?

say:6:1422640005:1.text: Hmm... this is even more tangled than I expected. It seems you've had quite an incredible journey together.
say:6:1422640005:1.source_cn: 唔，真是比我预想得还要更复杂的故事，看起来你们也经历了...

say:7:1422640006:1.text: As for the matter of lifting the curse, I cannot offer a direct answer. Yet, the events of that time are indeed recorded in the secret chronicles of the Sages.
say:7:1422640006:1.source_cn: 关于解除诅咒的疑问，我无法直接给出答案。但是，当年的历...

say:8:1422640007:1.text: In the time of the First Divine War, the gods and the Hypogeans met in fierce battle at Vaduso.
say:8:1422640007:1.source_cn: 那是第一次神魔战争期间，瓦度索曾经发生过一场神魔之战。

say:9:1422640008:1.text: At that time, the humans had not yet united under the banner of the Lightbearer Empire, but alongside Dura, they came seeking aid from our people.
say:9:1422640008:1.source_cn: 而艾雅就在那时，带着尚未被称为耀光的人类前来寻求援助。

say:10:1422640009:1.text: The war had not yet touched the Dark Forest, for the Lucent Tree's protection kept us safe...
say:10:1422640009:1.source_cn: 虽说战火尚未蔓延到薄暮丛林，且有流荧树的庇护——

say:11:1422640010:1.text: Yet, after careful deliberation, the Sages of that era weighed the risks and benefits, ultimately deciding to dispatch an elite troop with the Sylvan Egg to support Dura and the humans.
say:11:1422640010:1.source_cn: 但当时的贤者们权衡再三，决定借出翡绿之卵并派遣一支精锐...

choice_prompt:12:1422640010.text: Yet, after careful deliberation, the Sages of that era weighed the risks and benefits, ultimately deciding to dispatch an elite troop with the Sylvan Egg to support Dura and the humans.
choice_prompt:12:1422640010.source_cn: 但当时的贤者们权衡再三，决定借出翡绿之卵并派遣一支精锐队伍前去支援。

say:14:1422640011:0.text: Back then, we were also governed by the Three Sages, and if I recall correctly, it was Sage Tasso who led us during that time.
say:14:1422640011:0.source_cn: 当时也是三贤制，为首的贤者是塔萨贤者。

say:15:1422640012:0.text: Wait, what? Sage Tasso was Feli's ancestor and one of the very founders who helped Queen Seralyth establish the city of Sal'thorin.
say:15:1422640012:0.source_cn: 这……塔萨贤者是斐利尔的先祖，也是辅助奈萨雷斯建立萨洛...

choice:12:0:1.text: Who were the Sages of that time?
choice:12:0:1.male: Who were the Sages of that time?
choice:12:0:1.female: Who were the Sages of that time?

say:17:1422640013:0.text: Indeed, the Sylvan Egg you once wielded, which holds within it a fragment of Misarte's divine power...
say:17:1422640013:0.source_cn: 没错，就是你们曾经获得的翡绿之卵，它蕴藏着弥萨忒的一部...

say:18:1422640014:0.text: The Wilders of that era bore this sacred relic to aid Dura, a testament to their unwavering sincerity.
say:18:1422640014:0.source_cn: 绿裔族人携带此宝前去援助艾雅，可见诚意非凡。

say:20:1422640015:0.text: It was mainly composed of a select group of Dusk Patrollers. Their captain was said to be a formidable woman.
say:20:1422640015:0.source_cn: 确实如此，主要是由当时守卫薄暮丛林的巡游者组成。队长是...

say:21:1422640016:0.text: A formidable woman... I cannot think of anyone else more formidable than Seralyth.
say:21:1422640016:0.source_cn: 强大的女性……或许是奈萨雷斯。

say:22:1422640017:1.text: Our chronicles do not go into detail, but based on your history, it could be her.
say:22:1422640017:1.source_cn: 贤者手札中并未详述，但根据你们历史推断，应当是她。

choice:12:2:3.text: Who was in this elite troop?
choice:12:2:3.male: Who was in this elite troop?
choice:12:2:3.female: Who was in this elite troop?

say:23:1422640018:0.text: The battle unfolded with little difficulty, and Dura swiftly sealed the remaining Hypogeans. The Wilders who had gone to offer their support returned home unscathed.
say:23:1422640018:0.source_cn: 战斗本身很顺利，后续恶魔们也被艾雅封印。支援的绿裔们也...

say:24:1422640019:0.text: However... the Hypogeans infected the Sylvan Egg with a parasite.
say:24:1422640019:0.source_cn: 但是……翡绿之卵被恶魔寄生了。

say:25:1422640020:1.text: Master Arden! You never mentioned any of this!
say:25:1422640020:1.source_cn: 雅顿老师，恶魔、寄生、翡绿之卵？

say:26:1422640021:0.text: Hahaha! Scared you, didn't I? But yes...
say:26:1422640021:0.source_cn: 哦呵呵，不错不错，是不是吓了你一跳啊？

say:27:1422640022:0.text: Oh dear, seems I've startled our guests as well. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> might get the wrong impression about us Wilders.
say:27:1422640022:0.source_cn: 这位新朋友也是这副模样，这不是会让<style=str...
say:27:1422640022:0.male: Oh dear, seems I've startled our guests as well. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> might get the wrong impression about us Wilders.
say:27:1422640022:0.female: Oh dear, seems I've startled our guests as well. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> might get the wrong impression about us Wilders.

say:28:1422640023:3.text: To be honest, we're all scared by what you said.
say:28:1422640023:3.source_cn: ……说实话，不只是绿裔的问题，我们都被您的话吓到了。

say:29:1422640024:0.text: It's not the time for jokes, Master Arden. Let's get back to what you were saying.
say:29:1422640024:0.source_cn: 别开玩笑了，雅顿老师。我们还是回到正题吧。

say:30:1422640025:1.text: I've never heard of the Sylvan Egg being infected by a parasite.
say:30:1422640025:1.source_cn: 我从未听说过，翡绿之卵曾经被寄生之事。

say:31:1422640026:1.text: Few remember this chapter of history, and even the records speak of it only in passing. It is said that Misarte, upon learning of the parasite, was enraged and personally severed the tainted part.
say:31:1422640026:1.source_cn: 了解这段历史的人确实寥寥无几。在手札中也是轻描淡写。大...

say:32:1422640027:1.text: Thereafter, a curse befell the Wilders who had the Sylvan Egg and took part in the battle.
say:32:1422640027:1.source_cn: 然后，对那些借出翡绿之卵和参战的绿裔降下严厉诅咒。

say:33:1422640028:1.text: You should already know the rest of the story.
say:33:1422640028:1.source_cn: 剩下的事情，你们应该也已经知晓了。

choice_prompt:34:1422640028.text: You should already know the rest of the story.
choice_prompt:34:1422640028.source_cn: 剩下的事情，你们应该也已经知晓了。

say:35:1422640029:1.text: In theory, if that part has not been wholly infected by the Hypogeans, it should yet hold a fragment of Misarte's divine power.
say:35:1422640029:1.source_cn: 从理论上讲，若那部分未被恶魔完全侵蚀，应该还保留有弥萨...

choice_prompt:36:1422640029.text: In theory, if that part has not been wholly infected by the Hypogeans, it should yet hold a fragment of Misarte's divine power.
choice_prompt:36:1422640029.source_cn: 从理论上讲，若那部分未被恶魔完全侵蚀，应该还保留有弥萨忒的部分神力。

say:37:1422640030:4.text: The Sylvan Tendril! Could it be...?!
say:37:1422640030:4.source_cn: 这是织叶？！难道说织叶的来源是——

say:38:1422640031:0.text: Unbelievable... This is, without doubt, a part of the Sylvan Egg.
say:38:1422640031:0.source_cn: ……这，不可思议！这确实是与翡绿之卵同源的另一部分。

say:39:1422640032:0.text: So, a part of the Sylvan Egg was really severed... and Misarte did it herself...
say:39:1422640032:0.source_cn: 所以，翡绿之卵真的曾经被削去？还是弥萨忒亲自——

say:40:1422640033:0.text: No power of the mortal world could harm any part of the Sylvan Egg. It had to be Misarte herself.
say:40:1422640033:0.source_cn: 如果不是弥萨忒的伟力，凡间之力也不可能破坏神圣的翡绿之卵。

say:41:1422640034:1.text: But it's strange. I can't feel any of the Hypogeans' taint in the Sylvan Tendril. Magister Merlin, can you sense anything?
say:41:1422640034:1.source_cn: 但，奇怪啊，我无法从织叶之上感受到恶魔之力，梅林，你能...
say:41:1422640034:1.male: But it's strange. I can't feel any of the Hypogeans' taint in the Sylvan Tendril. Magister Merlin, can you sense anything?
say:41:1422640034:1.female: But it's strange. I can't feel any of the Hypogeans' taint in the Sylvan Tendril. Magister Merlin, can you sense anything?

choice_prompt:42:1422640034.text: But it's strange. I can't feel any of the Hypogeans' taint in the Sylvan Tendril. Magister Merlin, can you sense anything?
choice_prompt:42:1422640034.source_cn: 但，奇怪啊，我无法从织叶之上感受到恶魔之力，梅林，你能察觉到什么吗？
choice_prompt:42:1422640034.male: But it's strange. I can't feel any of the Hypogeans' taint in the Sylvan Tendril. Magister Merlin, can you sense anything?
choice_prompt:42:1422640034.female: But it's strange. I can't feel any of the Hypogeans' taint in the Sylvan Tendril. Magister Merlin, can you sense anything?

say:43:1422640035:1.text: Not only that... Magister Merlin used the Sylvan Tendril to lift the curse from Feli and me. That's the reason I'm here now.
say:43:1422640035:1.source_cn: 不止如此，梅林还用织叶为斐利尔和我都解除了身上的诅咒，...
say:43:1422640035:1.male: Not only that... Magister Merlin used the Sylvan Tendril to lift the curse from Feli and me. That's the reason I'm here now.
say:43:1422640035:1.female: Not only that... Magister Merlin used the Sylvan Tendril to lift the curse from Feli and me. That's the reason I'm here now.

say:44:1422640036:1.text: This is indeed puzzling. I cannot believe that Misarte would pass such harsh judgment without just cause.
say:44:1422640036:1.source_cn: 这确实令人费解。我相信弥萨忒不会无缘无故施加如此严厉的惩罚。

say:45:1422640037:1.text: The chronicles offer no specifics on the parasitic process, but they do note that Dura did not make use of the Sylvan Egg.
say:45:1422640037:1.source_cn: 在手札的记载中，对于寄生的过程与恶魔的状态语焉不详，但...

say:46:1422640038:1.text: How did the Hypogeans infect the Sylvan Egg?
say:46:1422640038:1.source_cn: 没有使用翡绿之卵？那恶魔是怎样寄生的？

say:47:1422640039:1.text: This is the very heart of the mystery. The records also hint that Misarte's wrath was not solely aimed at those Wilders, but also at Dura.
say:47:1422640039:1.source_cn: 正是这个疑点。而且记载还暗示弥萨忒的怒火不仅针对那些绿...

say:48:1422640040:1.text: This very point has sparked debate among Sages throughout the ages, for Misarte is known not for her rage and vengeful spirit, but for her kindness and tolerance as a goddess.
say:48:1422640040:1.source_cn: 历代贤者对此都有争论，因为弥萨忒一向以仁慈宽容著称，并...

choice_prompt:49:1422640040.text: This very point has sparked debate among Sages throughout the ages, for Misarte is known not for her rage and vengeful spirit, but for her kindness and tolerance as a goddess.
choice_prompt:49:1422640040.source_cn: 历代贤者对此都有争论，因为弥萨忒一向以仁慈宽容著称，并非易怒或好战的神明。

say:50:1422640041:1.text: The only thing I recall is the time <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I defeated a Hypofiend inside the Temple of Helthor.
say:50:1422640041:1.source_cn: 恶魔吗？我唯一能想到的就是我和<style=stres...
say:50:1422640041:1.male: The only thing I recall is the time <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I defeated a Hypofiend inside the Temple of Helthor.
say:50:1422640041:1.female: The only thing I recall is the time <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I defeated a Hypofiend inside the Temple of Helthor.

say:51:1422640042:1.text: It was hidden in the divine bow of the dwarven god Helthor.
say:51:1422640042:1.source_cn: 这个恶魔藏于矮人信奉的神明——赫托的神弓当中。

say:52:1422640043:1.text: Though Hypogeans and Hypofiends differ in appearance, they are fundamentally the same. Yet, to dwell within a divine weapon and remain unharmed... that is rather unusual.
say:52:1422640043:1.source_cn: 恶魔和魔物虽有区别，但本质相通。而寄居于神器又不被其伤...

say:53:1422640044:1.text: Rather than speculate any further, perhaps it's best we seek the answer straight from the Deer Spirit.
say:53:1422640044:1.source_cn: 这样，与其胡乱猜测，不如我们省点工夫，直接去问鹿灵吧。

choice:49:0:1.text: Could it be related to the Hypogeans?
choice:49:0:1.male: Could it be related to the Hypogeans?
choice:49:0:1.female: Could it be related to the Hypogeans?

choice:42:0:1.text: I sense nothing of the Hypogeans.
choice:42:0:1.male: I sense nothing of the Hypogeans.
choice:42:0:1.female: I sense nothing of the Hypogeans.

choice:34:0:1.text: Did the other part have Misarte's power?
choice:34:0:1.source_cn: 被削去的部分会蕴含弥萨忒之力吗？
choice:34:0:1.male: Did the other part have Misarte's power?
choice:34:0:1.female: Did the other part have Misarte's power?

choice:5:0:1.text: So, the Essail and the Dark Forest...
choice:5:0:1.source_cn: （解释艾塞勒与薄暮丛林的渊源）
choice:5:0:1.male: So, the Essail and the Dark Forest...
choice:5:0:1.female: So, the Essail and the Dark Forest...
